title: Colors with Dang (Green and Blue) 🎶 #shorts #nurseryrhymes
description:
Sing along with us! 🎶

Lyrics :
Red and yellow, green and blue,
green is like the big fir tree,
all the colors, me and you!
and the froggy, hop with me!

Red and yellow, green and blue,
blue is like the sky so high,
all the colors, me and you!
like Ding's scarf, oh my, oh my!

Red and yellow, green and blue,
red is like a strawberry,
all the colors, me and you!
and the apple on the tree!

Original song by Ding Dang Nursery Rhymes: original lyrics, music and animation. Synthetic voice: Piper ("lessac" voice).

#nurseryrhymes #kidssongs #singalong
